caption: 2D detection scores. Macro precision, recall, and F1 on the 300 annotated micrographs for the four base pickers.
note: Scores are against the CryoPPP annotations, matched one to one in order of increasing distance with a match radius of d/2, averaged per micrograph (macro), and computed with the same code for every picker at each picker's own default operating point. Three decimals, as the paper prints them; the resolution values elsewhere use two. The row named CryoTransformer in the paper is the release condition `baseline`. `possible_training_overlap` is true for crYOLO on EMPIAR-10081, which is part of the training data of crYOLO's general model, and for Topaz on all four entries, whose released general model has undocumented training data; the paper greys those values and excludes them from the ranking. This table carries no resolution, so the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat does not apply to it. The paper says 300 annotated micrographs; the scorer evaluates the micrographs that actually carry annotations, which is 300 / 295 / 295 / 300 for 10081 / 10093 / 10345 / 10532. Only the `baseline` row has unrounded values recorded anywhere, in data/revision/ablation_2d_metrics.json; for the other three pickers the notes give no value beyond the three decimals the paper prints, so `raw` is absent there.

provenance.source: supp.tex, tab:f1_vs_res; docs/notes/6_discussion.md, heading tab:cryosegnet_purified (which holds the provenance for this table) and heading tab:f1_vs_res; unrounded baseline values from data/revision/ablation_2d_metrics.json
provenance.detail: The notes give the origin as recon-aware-pick docs/2d_pick/baselines_common_metrics.md section 3.1, particle-wise macro values under a common greedy matcher at the same operating point as the stacks fed to reconstruction, but record no collection date. The ablation_2d_metrics.json recomputation that reproduces the baseline row to three decimals is dated 2026-08-25.

not_in_paper.note: A fourth block of pick counts was written into the table and then commented out on 2026-08-25, because no surviving passage read it. It counts the particles from the annotated micrographs that entered refinement, which on this 300-micrograph subset is effectively the extraction count. The values are recovered from the commented block in supp.tex.
not_in_paper.baseline_pick_count_discrepancy: The commented-out block gives 69,662 / 116,647 / 72,905 / 112,587 picks for CryoTransformer, while data/revision/ablation_2d_metrics.json, whose scores reproduce this row to three decimals, gives 77,328 / 118,314 / 87,447 / 116,753 candidates evaluated on the same micrographs. Nothing in the notes reconciles the two counts.

2d_scores_of_the_ablation_conditions.note: The same protocol applied to the particle stack each ablation condition delivers, in a table that was drafted and then cut from the paper. Full precision values are in revision/ablation_2d_metrics.json. Given here to three decimals in the order precision, recall, F1.
